svg.title: SRAM PUF authentication
svg.desc: A hardware root of trust for ESP32 chips with no secure element, built from their SRAM power-up fingerprint: 100% key reproducibility, and two attacks found and fixed. The strip shows real power-up bits, with metastable cells flickering across 10 cold boots.
svg.text: A root of trust for ESP32 chips with no secure
element, built from their SRAM alone.
